say:1:1430221101:1.text: I checked the front door. Not a thread in sight...
say:1:1430221101:1.source_cn: 我已经在门口看过了，还没有送来……
say:1:1430221101:1.male: I checked the front door. Not a thread in sight...
say:1:1430221101:1.female: I checked the front door. Not a thread in sight...

say:2:1430221102:1.text: I commissioned that damned dressmaker moons ago!
say:2:1430221102:1.source_cn: 尽管我提前许久就和制作裙子的裁缝下了订单——
say:2:1430221102:1.male: I commissioned that damned dressmaker moons ago!
say:2:1430221102:1.female: I commissioned that damned dressmaker moons ago!

say:3:1430221103:1.text: If my lady sees that there is no new dress for the party, it's the lash for me... or worse.
say:3:1430221103:1.source_cn: 如果主人没能在宴会前看到新裙子，她一定会惩罚我的。
say:3:1430221103:1.male: If my lady sees that there is no new dress for the party, it's the lash for me... or worse.
say:3:1430221103:1.female: If my lady sees that there is no new dress for the party, it's the lash for me... or worse.
